This distinguishes between water and space heating by sector (Residential/Tertiary/Industry), but is incomplete (missing countries and years). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Thermal demand" lists it under "Odyssee-Mure database yearly energy data for Europe". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support thermal (heat) demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
